name: Back scratch
instructions: Stand tall. Reach one hand over the same shoulder and down your back, palm facing your back and fingers pointing down. Log the side by this top arm.
Reach the other hand behind your lower back, palm facing out, and slide it up toward the top hand.
Try to touch or overlap the middle fingers without gripping or pulling them together.
Have someone measure the distance between the tips of the middle fingers.
Record overlap as a positive number and a gap as a negative number. Fingertips just touching is 0.
Take the best of two tries, then switch arms.
